title: Spacecraft Thermal Network Solver — Overview and definition
t: Spacecraft Thermal Network Solver — Overview and definition
description: Solves nodal thermal networks for spacecraft hot and cold cases.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Solves nodal thermal networks for spacecraft hot and cold cases. A spacecraft thermal network solver builds lumped-parameter nodal models with conduction, radiation (view factors), heaters, and MLI, solving steady-state and transient cases. Real implementations include Thermal Desktop/SINDA/FLUINT and ESATAN. It sizes heaters and radiators and validates against thermal balance tests. Engineering use only. Capability specification and design target: this database describes what the tool must do, not a claim of implementation or deployment.
